contributions.detail: Both Schedule A sheets close on their OWN printed page subtotal to the cent. p3 ('Page 2 of 5'): seventeen rows sum to 200 + 500 + 50 + 50 + 200 + 500 + 500 + 250 + 500 + 500 + 500 + 300 + 250 + 200 + 150 + 250 + 500 = 5,400.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $5400'. p4 ('Page 3 of 5'): a single row of 200.00 = its printed '$200'. 5,400 + 200 = 5,600.00 EXACTLY = the schedule's own printed Total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 5,600.00 (line 3 Balance at Beginning is a SLASHED ZERO, read 0 under the repo zero-glyph ruling, so this is the cycle's first report) and is NOT summed as an increment. The p2 ladder closes: 0 + 5,600.00 = 5,600.00; 5,600.00 - 5,565.54 = 34.46 = line 7. No row on either sheet is in-kind and no in-kind column is printed anywhere.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (5,565.54) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also the figure printed on BOTH Schedule B sheets' 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $5565.54', and is re-stated at summary line 6; and, per sheet, the two printed 'Subtotal for this page' figures 4,890.02 (p5) and 675.52 (p6)
expenditures.detail: TRACED TO ONE SHEET'S OWN SUBTOTAL, and NOTHING NUDGED. The 24 rows sum to 5,565.56, which is +0.02 against the anchor 5,565.54. The delta is located exactly: p6 ('Page 5 of 5') closes to the cent — its seven rows sum to 13.88 + 7.81 + 206.09 + 17.15 + 50.00 + 305.59 + 75.00 = 675.52 = its printed subtotal — while p5 ('Page 4 of 5') does not: its seventeen rows sum to 4,890.04 against its own printed 'Subtotal for this page $4890.02'. THE FILER'S ADDITION IS THE OUTLIER, NOT THE READING. Every one of p5's seventeen amounts was escalated in a ~900 dpi strip of the amount column and every digit is unambiguous (760.19 · 918.00 · 13.85 · 74.76 · 14.71 · 5.58 · 384.66 · 25.64 · 875.00 · 193.40 · 509.84 · 8.54 · 111.50 · 209.07 · 9.79 · 9.63 · 765.88), and the subtotal cell itself was escalated to 1400 dpi and reads '$ 4890.02' with no over-writing. So no cell can absorb the 0.02 and none was altered (§C5). The 0.02 propagates upward untouched: the filer's own Total (4,890.02 + 675.52 = 5,565.54) and the cover's Column A carry it, and the p2 ladder closes on its own terms at 34.46. CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN, within the document: the other THREE schedule sheets on this filing (both Schedule A pages and the second Schedule B page) each close to the cent, so this is a one-off addition slip on one sheet, not a habit. The filer's other 2014 reports are outside this chunk and were not opened; the attribution above does not depend on them.
